title: 通用病理与条件后果：RAG多跳可追溯性的三重稳健性分析
summary: 本文提出三重稳健性分析框架，固定检索架构，变化嵌入器、语料库和评判器，通过4440次主矩阵运行等实验，发现GraphRAG过度引用是架构普遍现象，但忠实性后果依赖语料库；单评判器LLM的忠实性评估脆弱，学习路由器可达到0.86的宏F1。
summary_en: This paper proposes a triple-robustness analysis framework, varying embedder, corpus, and judge while fixing retrieval architecture. Experiments show GraphRAG over-citation is universal, but faithfulness consequences are corpus-conditional; single-judge LLM faithfulness is fragile, and a learned router achieves macro-F1 0.86.
